rules.when: state transition is core and animation adds meaning
rules.caution: do not loop unless state is live/continuous

rules.when: dense product UI with quiet neutral voice
rules.decision: choose one family, not all three

rules.when: brand needs more weight/personality while retaining consistency
Material visual language or massive semantic coverage is already present
icon is decorative and text already communicates the action
rules.reason: absence is a valid art-direction choice

hardRules: do not mix more than two icon families on one surface without a written reason
do not use icons as bullet decoration by default
do not place a generic icon before every navigation label
do not use an icon when a word is clearer
